note: Expected strings are written out by hand from the model card, not generated from Guardian's formatter. That is the point: if a refactor changes the encoding, these stop matching. \u003c/s\u003e appears escaped in this file only because JSON has no raw form for it; the string on the wire is the literal five characters.

cases.name: bare string is one turn from the target speaker
cases.why: inference.py --text treats a plain string as a single t turn and still prepends the instruction block
cases.input: add me on Discord, my username is skyfox_4821
cases.expected:
Instruct: In the following chat messages from target speaker t and possibly other speakers s1, s2, etc., detect abuse by speaker t.
Query:

t: add me on Discord, my username is skyfox_4821

cases.name: the model card's own conversation example
cases.why: alice is the only other speaker, so she is s1 in both of her turns

input.speaker: t
input.text: add me on Discord, my username is skyfox_4821

cases.expected:
Instruct: In the following chat messages from target speaker t and possibly other speakers s1, s2, etc., detect abuse by speaker t.
Query:

s1: how can I contact you? </s> t: add me on Discord, my username is skyfox_4821 </s> s1: okay, got it

cases.name: other speakers are numbered by first appearance, not by name
cases.why: s1 and s2 are assigned in order of first appearance and stay stable for the rest of the window

input.speaker: t
input.text: whats your @ on the app with the ghost

cases.expected:
Instruct: In the following chat messages from target speaker t and possibly other speakers s1, s2, etc., detect abuse by speaker t.
Query:

s1: anyone else on tonight </s> s2: im here </s> t: whats your @ on the app with the ghost </s> s1: why do you need it

cases.name: the target speaker can open the window
cases.why: t is never renumbered and never becomes s1 even when it speaks first
cases.expected:
Instruct: In the following chat messages from target speaker t and possibly other speakers s1, s2, etc., detect abuse by speaker t.
Query:

t: hey </s> s1: hi </s> t: add me on snap

cases.name: text is passed through unchanged
cases.why: no lowercasing, no trimming, no normalization. The model saw chat noise in training and Guardian's own normalizer output must not be substituted for the raw turn.

input.speaker: t
input.text: D I S C O R D ?? 👻

cases.expected:
Instruct: In the following chat messages from target speaker t and possibly other speakers s1, s2, etc., detect abuse by speaker t.
Query:

t:   D I S C O R D ?? 👻

cases.name: a turn containing the separator is not re-escaped
cases.why: the formatter joins, it does not sanitize. Recording the behaviour so a future change is a decision rather than an accident.
cases.expected:
Instruct: In the following chat messages from target speaker t and possibly other speakers s1, s2, etc., detect abuse by speaker t.
Query:

t: i typed </s> by accident
